payload.title: Bug: mergeRunnerItemLocked's fgos-write-rejected check (src/runner/merge.mjs ~line 1276) fires…
payload.description: Bug: mergeRunnerItemLocked's fgos-write-rejected check (src/runner/merge.mjs ~line 1276) fires even when a merge=union auto-resolution cleanly staged a combined result for an append-only .fgos/*.jsonl file (events.jsonl, the sharded events/*.jsonl, or the tsk-2xg diagnostic logs) -- ANY staged .fgos/ path after the merge attempt is rejected outright, whether it came from a hard conflict or a clean union auto-merge. Since main is under constant heavy concurrent write load (many sessions), a worker branch's frozen .fgos/*.jsonl snapshot almost always differs from main's current growing copy by the time approve runs, so union-merge's auto-staged reconciliation trips this guard on nearly every approve for an old-lived branch -- confirmed live blocking tsk-3tp's and tsk-34o5's approve repeatedly today, each requiring manual git checkout HEAD -- <path> + re-commit to work around. tsk-2xg's own filed report proposed two fixes: (a) gitattributes merge=union (already done) and (b) auto git checkout --ours (repoRoot's own version) for EVERY .fgos/* path immediately after a successful git merge --no-commit, before the staged-diff check -- only option (a) was ever implemented. Fix: implement (b) in mergeRunnerItemLocked -- right after the merge succeeds (no exception), before computing stagedPaths, run git checkout HEAD -- for any .fgos/ path already staged, so the branch's own frozen .fgos state is restored and the check never trips for an auto-resolvable union merge. Only fall through to the existing fgos-write-rejected/abort path if paths remain staged after that restore (a genuine non-union conflict).

payload.description: Bug: some fgos write path(s) -- confirmed at least 'fgos edit <id> --verify ...' -- still append directly to the frozen .fgos/events.jsonl baseline instead of routing through the sharded per-writer .fgos/events/<writer-id>-<ts>.jsonl path tsk-3ve/tsk-3tp introduced. Real events observed: tsk-26r's own work.move/work.outcome/work.edit events (seq 24089-24092, timestamps 2026-08-24T03:07-03:30Z) landed in .fgos/events.jsonl on main, not in a per-writer shard, well after tsk-3ve's migration and tsk-3tp-1's dual-write cutover fix (commit 41dcd479, which only fixed logExecutorDispatch in dispatch/cli.mjs and loop.mjs's dispatch audit append -- NOT the general/default event-append path every verb like edit/pick/return goes through). Consequence: events.jsonl is not actually frozen in practice, so any worker branch whose commit history predates a later direct-write keeps hitting real (non-empty) diffs against main for this file during catchup/approve -- worked around live by re-adding merge=union for .fgos/events.jsonl in .gitattributes (tsk-3tp), but the real fix is finding and routing the remaining direct-write call site(s) through the sharded writer path like tsk-3tp-1 already did for the two it found. Needs investigation: grep for direct fs.appendFileSync/writeFileSync calls against events.jsonl (not via resolveWriterLogPath) across src/, especially in whatever appendEventCore/general event-append helper 'fgos edit' itself calls.
